enso.advisory_text: 2 September 2026 : A moderate to strong El Niño is present in the Tropical Pacific. Climate models predict that the ongoing El Niño will continue until the first half of 2027 and may reach a very strong state before the end of 2026.                                                                           (updated: 26 August 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921

region2_forecast: LOCATION: 560 KM WEST OF ITBAYAT, BATANES (21.4°N, 116.5°E)
Ilocos Region, Itbayat, Aparri, Tuguegarao, Isabela, Cordillera Administrative Region, Central Luzon, National Capital Region, most areas of CALABARZON, and most areas of MIMAROPA,
Moderate to strong El Niño is present in the Tropical Pacific. Climate models predict that El Niño will continue until the first half of 2027 and may reach a very strong state before the end of 2026.

Gale warning is raised over the northern seaboard of Northern Luzon (Batanes) and the northern and western seaboards of Northern Luzon (Babuyan Islands, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union {Bangar, Luna, Balaoan, Bacnotan, San Juan, City of San Fernando} and Pangasinan {Bolinao, Bani, Agno, Burgos, Dasol}).
